frames.caption: JAMIE“DON’T LET GO— DON’T LET GO—”

frames.note: Four bikes under the streetlight
frames.caption: Under the streetlight across the street, four bikes stand in a row. The way you used to ride.

frames.name: x11-lange-front

frames.note: The kitchen: dinner for three, one plate untouched and still steaming; the cap on the chair
frames.caption: JAMIE“Somebody’s eating. Was eating.”

frames.note: It comes out of the bathroom and through his door; the chair goes
frames.caption: JAMIE“…Four bikes.”

frames.name: x17-lange-loom

frames.caption: JAMIE“NO—”

frames.name: x23-pantry-head
frames.note: Its head in the gap; you hold your breath
frames.caption: JAMIE“(It’s here. Don’t move— hold your breath—)”
